blockquote: Front matter is always written (id, title, created, modified, tags, properties); a multi-paragraph quote splits into separate quotes.
callout: Front matter is always written; the data-type="callout" HTML block is dropped.
cept-comment: Front matter is always written; cept:comment markers are dropped.
cept-front-matter: Front matter is regenerated: keys are reordered, id/modified/properties are added and created is re-quoted.
code-fences: Front matter is always written; a ~~~ fence is rewritten as ```.
columns: Front matter is always written; the data-type="columns" HTML block is dropped.
footnotes: Front matter is always written; the footnote reference and definition are dropped.
front-matter-bom: The byte order mark is lost and the front matter is regenerated.
front-matter-hugo: Front matter is regenerated: unknown keys (lastmod, draft, weight) are dropped and quoting changes.
front-matter-jekyll: A front matter block closed by ... is not recognised, so it is kept as body text after a new front matter block.
front-matter-obsidian: Front matter is regenerated: aliases, cssclasses and the YAML comment are dropped.
gfm-basics: Front matter is always written; _emphasis_ is rewritten as *emphasis*.
links-and-images: Front matter is always written; the autolink <https://...> is rewritten as an inline link.
lists: Front matter is always written; the nested list item is dropped.
math: Front matter is always written; the backslash escape in \, is lost inside $$ math.
mermaid: Front matter is always written; the mermaid fence is wrapped in cept:block comments.
no-front-matter: Front matter is added to a page that had none.
table: Front matter is always written; column padding and the :---- alignment marker are normalised.
toggle-details: Front matter is always written; <details>/<summary> toggles lose their summary and wrapper.
unknown-html: Front matter is always written; unknown HTML blocks and HTML comments are dropped.
